items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Well, I didn't know of any band he had. I just know that he played good connect, and I know he used to play around Chicago.

ctx.x: Before the tape machine was on, you mentioned this fella, Kepler?
Freddie? Freddie Kepler. Well, I didn't know of any band he had. I just know that he played good connect, and I know he used to play around Chicago. Oh, yeah. Uh-huh.
But you didn't know him personally?
